title: American-Style Zesty Grilled Chicken Salad
description: A refreshing summer salad featuring grilled chicken, mixed greens, and a zesty dressing.
instructions: 2. Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, and your favorite seasonings.
3. Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Let chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
5. In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cucumber, tomato, and red onion.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together zesty dressing ingredients.
7. Add sliced chicken to the bowl with the mixed greens and toss with zesty dressing.
8. Top with salad and serve immediately.
9. Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 24 hours.
